11.    ORDINANCE -2 READING Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
                                         -



       Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of MUR Mixed-Use Residential for land
       annexed to the City of Cheyenne located east of US-30 and north of and adjacent to East
       Pershing Boulevard. (SPONSOR MR. ROYBAL)
                                         —




Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 2M reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

12.    ORDINANCE -2” READING Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
                                         -



       Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from LI Light Industrial to CB Community
       Business for land located northeast of the intersection of Hutchins Drive and Industry
       Drive. (SPONSOR MR. ROYBAL)
                          -




Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2M reading, seconded by Mr. Layboum. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

13.    ORDINANCE -2” READING Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
                                         -



       Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from LR Low-Density Residential to CB
       Community Business for land located at 3501 Forest Drive (located southeast of the
       intersection of Pershing Boulevard and Forest Drive), (SPONSOR MR. ROYBAL)
                                                                        —




Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 2d reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Mr. Segrave moved to
postpone until the September 9, 2024, meeting of the governing body, seconded by Mr. Layboum.
Motion to postpone carried with Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Segrave voting “YES” and Dr. Rinne
voting “NO.”

Athan Mores, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Charles Bloom,
Planning & Development Department Director, and Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development
Department Senior Planner, provided additional information. Committee members Rinne and
Segrave commented on the item. Public comments were made by Andrew Bradfield; David Evens;
William Lewis, Cross Bridge Alliance Church; Nancy Loomis; Jason Siebert, Cross Bridge
Alliance Church; and Judy Treber.
